items.title: Jimmy Cobb — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: It was him – it would be him and Benny Golson.

ctx.x: Tenor player. Sounded like Gene Ammons. Had that big sound. You say, “Where’s it coming from?” Just a little guy like that. It was him – it would be him and Benny Golson. At that time, Benny Golson was playing like Dexter Gordon. So they would get on the stand, and they would go through that thing Gene and Dexter used to do. They used to do the repeat of it. They was very good at it, Benny being Dexter and what’s-his-name being – Carrington being Gene Ammons.
Where was the locus of that activity? Was that 7th and T?
